audit.why: The page already gets the central spike right: Mantra is live from level 1, Jayce's level 6 is only stance-swap stats, and his real early spike is cannon Q through the Acceleration Gate at 2-3. spikes[] holds four entries with real 'when' values.

audit.whatIsWrong: The stance swap is described purely as 'stat growth' and 'passive stance-swapping'. It is neither passive nor purely stats, and the page never mentions the resistance shred.
audit.why: Riot's text: swapping to Mercury Cannon means 'the first attack in this form reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist', on a 6s cooldown, and the swap resets his attack. That shred is what makes his follow-up poke hurt so much more than the numbers suggest, and the swap animation — not the ability cast — is the cue to step out.
audit.corrected: The 6s swap, the attack reset and the resistance shred written into the don'ts and the cooldown block. Soulflare replaced with Mantra-Q, and the 950 Q range added to whys[0].
